tools.name: AIS-catcher
tools.description: Turns an RTL-SDR or similar dongle and a small computer into an AIS receiver with a web map, and feeds AISHub or the commercial networks. Range is line of sight, a few tens of nautical miles.
tools.section: Raw feeds and your own receiver

tools.name: AISHub
tools.description: A pooled raw AIS feed and API that you get access to by contributing a live feed from your own receiver. Live data only.
tools.section: Raw feeds and your own receiver

tools.name: aisstream.io
tools.description: A live global WebSocket feed of AIS messages, filtered by bounding box or MMSI, with GitHub sign-in. No history, three connections per account, and connections must come from a server rather than a browser.
tools.section: Raw feeds and your own receiver

tools.name: AMSA vessel traffic data
tools.description: Monthly AIS shapefiles for the Australian search-and-rescue region, at roughly hourly positions. Good free history for the Indo-Pacific approaches.

tools.name: BarentsWatch AIS API
tools.description: Developer API over the Norwegian AIS feed with about two weeks of history. Norway only.

tools.name: Danish AIS data
tools.description: Daily files of AIS for Danish waters, the approach to the Baltic. The shore network moved to the Danish Emergency Management Agency; historical files are supplied on application.

tools.name: Digitraffic Marine
tools.description: Live AIS over REST and MQTT plus Portnet port-call schedules, with commercial use allowed. Finland and the northern Baltic only; requests need a `Digitraffic-User` header.

tools.name: Global Fishing Watch APIs
tools.description: Vessel search, events, presence grids from 2012 to about four days ago, and radar detections through a documented API with a Python client. No commercial licence is offered.

tools.name: Global Fishing Watch map
tools.description: Tracks from 2012, port visits, encounters, loitering, AIS gaps and radar detections for the whole world. Built around fishing and carrier vessels, and about three days behind live.
tools.section: Live maps with a free tier

tools.name: Kystverket AIS
tools.description: A live API for the Norwegian economic zone with no registration, plus historical files back to 2005 that include Norway's own satellite AIS. Small fishing and leisure craft are excluded, and full history needs an application.

tools.name: MarineCadastre vessel traffic
tools.description: Bulk US-waters AIS from 2009 to the previous year, filtered to one position a minute, with GeoParquet files from 2024 onward. The deepest free raw AIS archive anywhere, but US waters only.

tools.name: MarineTraffic
tools.description: The largest crowd-sourced AIS map, with vessel pages, port calls and photos. Free accounts see about a day of track and no port calls or ownership; Kpler has owned it since March 2023 and the free tier has narrowed since.
tools.section: Live maps with a free tier

tools.name: MyShipTracking
tools.description: Terrestrial AIS map with a credit-based API and a free trial key. Coverage is near-shore only.
tools.section: Live maps with a free tier

tools.name: OpenCPN
tools.description: A chart plotter that shows AIS from your receiver over real charts and keeps a local log. Useful for offline analysis of your own feed.
tools.section: Raw feeds and your own receiver

tools.name: ShipAtlas
tools.description: Satellite AIS positions, recent port calls and a sea-route calculator. The free tier is capped at ten satellite position views.
tools.section: Live maps with a free tier

tools.name: Shipinfo.net
tools.description: AIS map with waterway and port-congestion analytics and Northern Sea Route ice layers. Operated from Russia, so think about what you query from a case machine.
tools.section: Live maps with a free tier

tools.name: ShipXplorer
tools.description: AIS map fed by hobbyist receivers, from the company behind ShipSpotting. Hosting a receiver earns a premium account.
tools.section: Live maps with a free tier

tools.name: VesselFinder
tools.description: Live map and vessel particulars with the cheapest paid route to longer tracks (3, 7 or 90 days by tier). Its terms forbid scraping and building datasets.
tools.section: Live maps with a free tier

tools.name: ABS Record
tools.description: Class records for ABS-classed ships.

tools.name: Black Sea MoU
tools.description: Inspection records for the Black Sea states. The public database is developed and hosted by the Russian Federation, and may not load from every network.

tools.name: ClassNK Register of Ships
tools.description: Class records for the Japanese society's large fleet.

tools.name: DNV Vessel Register
tools.description: Class status, surveys and certificates for ships classed by DNV.

tools.name: Equasis
tools.owner: EMSA and a consortium of maritime administrations
tools.description: Particulars, registered owner and managers, class, P&I cover and port state inspections for most merchant ships, and from 2026 a record of ship-to-ship transfers. The first stop for any vessel.

tools.name: IMO GISIS
tools.description: The IMO's own ship and company records: name and flag history, IMO company numbers and registered addresses. The public modules need a free IMO web account.

tools.name: Indian Ocean MoU
tools.description: Inspection and detention data for the Indian Ocean region.

tools.name: ITU MARS ship station search
tools.description: Looks up a ship by MMSI, call sign, name or distress-beacon identity and returns the administration that registered it. The quickest check that an MMSI matches a flag.

tools.name: Liberian Registry
tools.description: Public vessel and certificate lookups for the Liberian flag.

tools.name: Marshall Islands Registry
tools.description: Public information and lookups for the Marshall Islands flag.

tools.name: Panama Maritime Authority
tools.description: The world's largest flag registry; its public pages hold registry notices and verification services.

tools.name: ShipSpotting
tools.description: Dated, crowd-sourced ship photos, useful for confirming a hull, a livery or a name change. Browsing is free; uploading needs an account.

tools.name: Superyachts.com Top 100
tools.description: Rankings and owner searches for the largest yachts, useful in sanctions and asset-tracing work.

tools.name: THETIS (Paris MoU)
tools.description: Inspection and detention records for ships calling in Europe, Canada and Russia's European ports.

tools.name: Tokyo MoU APCIS
tools.description: Asia-Pacific inspection records in near real time. The database is hosted in Vladivostok.

tools.name: USCG PSIX
tools.description: Weekly snapshot of Coast Guard records: particulars, inspections, deficiencies and detentions for ships in US waters.

tools.name: ArcNautical
tools.description: Screens one IMO number against the OFAC, EU, UK and UN lists without an account, states which lists it could reach, and offers a keyless JSON endpoint. Launched in 2026; cross-check its result against OpenSanctions and the official lists.

tools.name: Combined IUU Vessel List
tools.description: Every regional fisheries organisation's list of vessels caught fishing illegally, merged with Interpol notices, with name and flag history, alerts and a spreadsheet download.

tools.name: EU Sanctions Map
tools.description: Every EU sanctions regime with the legal acts and the listed persons, entities and vessels.

tools.name: FAO Global Record
tools.description: The Global Record of Fishing Vessels, with a unique vessel identifier and quick search by IMO, MMSI or call sign.

tools.name: GLEIF LEI search
tools.description: Legal entity identifiers with registered addresses and parent relationships for companies that have one. Good for banks, traders and larger shipowners.

tools.name: ICCAT Record of Vessels
tools.owner: International Commission for the Conservation of Atlantic Tunas
tools.description: Authorised vessels and the Atlantic IUU list.

tools.name: ICIJ Offshore Leaks Database
tools.description: Companies, officers and addresses from the Panama Papers, Paradise Papers, Pandora Papers and related leaks. The usual way into offshore shipowning structures.

tools.name: IOTC vessel records
tools.description: Authorised and IUU vessel lists for the Indian Ocean.

tools.name: KSE Institute Shadow Fleet Tracker
tools.description: Monthly reports on Russian seaborne oil exports and the tankers carrying them. Reports and data downloads rather than a vessel search.

tools.name: OCCRP Aleph
tools.owner: Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project
tools.description: Searchable archive of company registries, leaks and documents. Some collections are open only to journalists.

tools.name: OFAC Sanctions List Search
tools.description: The official search of US designations, including vessels by IMO number.

tools.name: OpenCorporates
tools.description: The largest open database of companies and officers, with searches free on the web and the API and bulk data paid. Free API access is available to public-benefit projects on application.

tools.name: OpenSanctions
tools.description: Consolidated sanctions and politically exposed person data from more than a hundred sources, with vessels as entities matched to IMO numbers, flag histories and shadow-fleet tags. Commercial use needs a licence.

tools.name: UANI tanker tracker
tools.description: A running list of several hundred tankers linked to Iranian oil. UANI is an advocacy group, so confirm against the official lists before you rely on an entry.

tools.name: UK Sanctions List
tools.owner: UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office
tools.description: The UK's consolidated designations, including ships specified under the Russia regime.

tools.name: UN Security Council Consolidated List
tools.description: All individuals, entities and vessels listed by the Council's sanctions committees.

tools.name: WCPFC vessel records
tools.owner: Western and Central Pacific Fisheries Commission
tools.description: The record of vessels authorised to fish in the western and central Pacific, and the commission's IUU list.

tools.name: Bellingcat Ship Detection Tool
tools.description: Counts and plots ships in Sentinel-1 radar imagery for any area and date range, including ships with AIS off. Runs in Google Earth Engine; Bellingcat's 2023 guide explains the method.

tools.name: Capella Open Data
tools.description: Sample high-resolution radar scenes on AWS. Capella has been owned by IonQ since July 2025.

tools.name: Copernicus Browser
tools.owner: European Space Agency for the European Commission
tools.description: Sentinel-1 radar and Sentinel-2 optical imagery with search, time-lapse and download. Sentinel-1 is back to a six-day revisit since the 1C and 1D satellites came into service in 2025 and 2026.

tools.name: Copernicus Data Space
tools.description: The APIs behind the browser (STAC, OData and processing) for pulling Sentinel data into your own tools.

tools.name: EOS LandViewer
tools.description: Browser for Sentinel, Landsat and some commercial imagery with analysis tools; the free tier allows a small number of scenes a month.

tools.name: Global Fishing Watch data portal
tools.description: Downloads of radar vessel detections matched to AIS (from 2017), fishing effort and other derived datasets. The radar layer is the simplest global view of unmatched, likely dark, vessels.

tools.name: NASA FIRMS
tools.description: Active fire and thermal anomaly detections, including flaring at offshore platforms and fires at sea.

tools.name: NASA Worldview
tools.description: Same-day, low-resolution global imagery from MODIS and VIIRS, enough to see weather, smoke, ice and large slicks.

tools.name: SkyFi
tools.description: Marketplace for buying archive imagery or new tasking from several satellite operators by the scene, for people who need one picture rather than a contract.

tools.name: Skylight
tools.description: Maritime monitoring platform that fuses AIS, radar and optical detections into alerts, free to governments, regional bodies and NGOs working on illegal fishing and maritime security.

tools.name: SkyTruth Cerulean
tools.description: Oil slicks detected in Sentinel-1 radar, with the likely source vessel or platform suggested from AIS, through a map and an API. Vessel attribution runs a few days behind.

tools.name: Umbra Open Data
tools.description: Very high-resolution radar imagery of about twenty fixed sites, some of them ports, with no sign-up. A good way to learn what commercial SAR can show.

tools.name: Vantor Discover
tools.description: Browse previews of the commercial high-resolution archive for free; buying a scene is quote-based. The portal kept its Maxar address after the 2025 rename.

tools.name: Vantor Open Data Program
tools.description: High-resolution before-and-after imagery released for major disasters as a catalogue on AWS. Event-driven rather than on demand, and non-commercial use only.

tools.name: VIIRS Boat Detection
tools.owner: Earth Observation Group, Colorado School of Mines
tools.description: Nightly detections of lit fishing boats from the VIIRS day-night band, useful for squid and other light-attracting fleets.

tools.name: Container Port Performance Index
tools.owner: World Bank and S&P Global Market Intelligence
tools.description: Annual ranking of container ports by time in port, built from AIS, as a report and data file.

tools.name: Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker
tools.description: LNG terminals and gas pipelines worldwide, with ownership and status, downloadable after a short form.

tools.name: IMF PortWatch
tools.owner: International Monetary Fund with the University of Oxford
tools.description: Daily port calls and trade volume estimates for about 1,800 ports and transit counts for the main chokepoints, updated weekly, with an ArcGIS API. The figures are modelled from AIS and get revised.

tools.name: Marine Regions
tools.description: Exclusive economic zones, territorial seas and other maritime boundaries as downloadable geodata. The reference layer for "whose waters is this ship in".

tools.name: NGA World Port Index
tools.description: Publication 150: location, depths, facilities and services for several thousand ports, as a spreadsheet or GIS layer.

tools.name: OpenInfraMap
tools.description: Power lines, telecoms, oil and gas infrastructure drawn from OpenStreetMap, including offshore platforms and pipelines.

tools.name: Port Optimizer
tools.owner: Port of Los Angeles with Wabtec
tools.description: Volumes, forecasts and container tracking for the port of Los Angeles. One of the few ports that publishes forward-looking data.

tools.name: SubTel Forum Cable Map
tools.description: A second cable map that also shows the cable-ship fleet and planned systems.

tools.name: TeleGeography Submarine Cable Map
tools.description: The standard interactive map of submarine cables and landing stations, covering 694 systems in its 2026 edition.

tools.name: UNCTAD Liner Shipping Connectivity Index
tools.description: Quarterly index of how well each country and port is connected to container shipping networks, inside the UNCTADstat data centre.

tools.name: BIC container owner codes
tools.description: The register behind the first three letters of every container number: who owns or operates the box.

tools.name: Drewry World Container Index
tools.description: Weekly spot container rates on the main east-west routes. The headline figures are free; the detail is a subscription.

tools.name: Eurostat Comext
tools.description: EU trade in goods at eight-digit product detail by partner country and month.

tools.name: Freightos Baltic Index
tools.description: Daily container spot index by lane; headline rates are free and the full series is paid.

tools.name: ImportYeti
tools.description: US import bills of lading searchable by company, supplier and product, free with limits on how much detail you see. The free way into the data Panjiva and ImportGenius sell.

tools.name: ITC Trade Map
tools.description: Trade flows, tariffs and market indicators by product and country, with company directories for some markets.

tools.name: OEC
tools.description: Visual explorer of trade flows by country and product, built on Comtrade and national data. Good for a first picture; check the numbers at source.

tools.name: Open Supply Hub
tools.description: An open database of production facilities with names, addresses and the brands that list them. Search and downloads are free; the API is paid.

tools.name: Resource Trade Earth
tools.description: Trade in natural resources (fuels, metals, agricultural goods) by country pair, with maps and downloads.

tools.name: SeaRates container tracking
tools.description: Tracks by container, bill of lading or booking number across most carriers and shows the carrying vessel's position. Free lookups are limited without an account.

tools.name: ShipsGo
tools.description: Multi-carrier container tracking with a few free lookups, then per-shipment credits and an API.

tools.name: Track-Trace
tools.description: Sends a container number to the right page of about 170 carriers. Nothing stored, nothing to sign up for.

tools.name: UN Comtrade
tools.description: Bilateral trade by product code for almost every country, with a free API key subject to daily limits.

tools.name: USA Trade Online
tools.description: US imports and exports at ten-digit detail by country, district and port.

tools.name: WITS
tools.description: Trade and tariff data with bulk download and an API, drawing on Comtrade and tariff databases.

tools.name: ACLED
tools.owner: Armed Conflict Location and Event Data
tools.description: Coded political violence and protest events worldwide, including attacks on ports and shipping, downloadable after registration.

tools.name: Eyes on Russia map
tools.description: Verified, geolocated incidents from the war in Ukraine, including Black Sea and port events, built with C4ADS.

tools.name: IMB
tools.description: Runs the 24-hour Piracy Reporting Centre that collects attack reports worldwide and publishes quarterly statistics and an incident map.

tools.name: Liveuamap
tools.description: Geolocated news events, including strikes on shipping and ports in the Black Sea and the Red Sea. Ad-supported, with an optional ad-free subscription.

tools.name: MARA
tools.description: Our maritime security intelligence platform: round-the-clock monitoring of security incidents with alerts, intelligence reports, daily hot spots and country and port indices. Feedback and the public roadmap are on GitHub.

tools.name: Maritime Security Centre Indian Ocean
tools.description: Threat assessments, incident updates and voluntary registration for ships transiting the Red Sea, Gulf of Aden and western Indian Ocean. The successor to MSCHOA, the Horn of Africa centre.

tools.name: MICA Center
tools.description: The Brest centre that hosts MDAT-GoG, the French and British reporting and advisory service for the Gulf of Guinea, and publishes annual and weekly maritime security reports.

tools.name: NGA Maritime Safety Information
tools.description: Navigation warnings, broadcast warnings and the Anti-Shipping Activity Messages (ASAM) database, a geocoded record of attacks and suspicious approaches going back to the 1980s.

tools.name: ONI Worldwide Threat to Shipping
tools.description: Weekly summary of threats and incidents by region, compiled from the reporting centres and open sources.

tools.name: Phantom Tide
tools.access_note: Starter tier; higher tiers exist, prices not published, 2026-10
tools.description: Analyst dashboard that ranks hotspots where vessel tracks, aircraft, navigation warnings, weather, satellite detections and GNSS interference overlap, with a notebook and area reports. A hosted app with closed source; the public repository holds the docs and release notes.

tools.name: ReCAAP ISC
tools.description: Incident reports, weekly and annual statistics and a searchable map for piracy and armed robbery in Asia. The dashboard needs a free account.

tools.name: UKMTO
tools.description: Advisories and incident reports for the Red Sea, Gulf of Aden, Arabian Sea and the Gulf, and the voluntary reporting scheme ships use there.

tools.name: Baidu Maps
tools.description: Coverage and street views of Chinese ports. It uses its own shifted coordinate system, so convert before you compare positions.

tools.name: Bing Maps
tools.description: A second aerial imagery source, often from a different date than Google's, with bird's-eye views of many ports.

tools.name: Copernicus Marine
tools.description: Ocean current, wave, temperature and sea-ice datasets, for drift and feasibility analysis.

tools.name: DualMaps
tools.description: Road map, aerial view and Street View side by side for one point.

tools.name: earth.nullschool
tools.description: Animated global wind, ocean current and wave fields, with a time slider.

tools.name: EMODnet
tools.description: European marine data: bathymetry, human activities (cables, pipelines, wind farms, dredging) and more as map layers and downloads.

tools.name: GEBCO
tools.description: The global bathymetry grid. Can a ship of this draught be where its AIS says it is?

tools.name: GeoNames
tools.description: Gazetteer of place names with coordinates and alternate spellings, for matching ports named in several languages.

tools.name: Google Earth
tools.description: The desktop Pro version has a historical imagery slider, the easiest way to watch a berth, a terminal or a shipyard change over years.

tools.name: KartaView
tools.description: Crowd-sourced street-level photos, useful where Street View has nothing.

tools.name: Navionics ChartViewer
tools.description: Worldwide nautical charts with depths and anchorages in the browser.

tools.name: NOAA ENC Viewer
tools.description: US electronic navigational charts in the browser.

tools.name: OpenSeaMap
tools.description: A nautical overlay on OpenStreetMap: buoys, lights, harbours and anchorages.

tools.name: OpenStreetMap
tools.description: Community-mapped berths, terminals, piers and port infrastructure with tags you can query.

tools.name: PeakFinder
tools.description: Draws the mountain skyline from any viewpoint, which geolocates many coastal photographs.

tools.name: WikiMapia
tools.description: Crowd-labelled places, including industrial sites, terminals and naval facilities that official maps leave blank.

tools.name: Windy
tools.description: Wind, wave, swell and current forecasts and recent history from several models. A quick check on whether a claimed speed or route makes sense.

tools.name: Yandex Maps
tools.description: The best coverage and street panoramas for Russian and Central Asian ports.

tools.name: Zoom Earth
tools.description: Near-real-time weather satellite imagery and storm tracks that affect shipping routes.

tools.name: Altana
tools.description: Supply chain network mapping across shipment and corporate records.

tools.name: Ambrey
tools.description: Maritime security advisories, intelligence and armed guarding.

tools.name: Datalastic
tools.description: A developer-oriented AIS and vessel data API, one of the cheaper paid routes to programmatic positions.

tools.name: Descartes Datamyne
tools.description: Import and export records for the Americas and beyond.

tools.name: Dryad Global
tools.description: Maritime risk intelligence and advisories, with some free weekly commentary.

tools.name: HawkEye 360
tools.description: Radio-frequency geolocation and maritime domain awareness products for governments.

tools.name: ICEYE
tools.description: Tasked high-resolution radar imagery and dark vessel detection products.

tools.name: ImportGenius
tools.description: US and other customs shipment records with published subscription plans.

tools.name: Kharon
tools.description: Research and data on sanctions, export controls and the networks around designated parties.

tools.name: Kpler
tools.description: Commodity flows, cargo tracking and the combined MarineTraffic, FleetMon and Spire AIS feeds, sold as a platform and as data.

tools.name: Linerlytica
tools.description: Container shipping market analysis and port congestion tracking.

tools.name: Lloyd's List Intelligence
tools.description: Seasearcher vessel database, risk and compliance screening, casualty records and the Lloyd's List news service.

tools.name: Panjiva
tools.description: Bills of lading and shipment records for many countries, with company profiles and network views.

tools.name: Planet
tools.description: Daily optical imagery of the whole land surface and coasts, plus the Sentinel Hub APIs under the Planet Insights Platform.

tools.name: Pole Star Global
tools.description: PurpleTRAC sanctions screening and fleet monitoring, widely used by banks and traders.

tools.name: Risk Intelligence
tools.description: The MaRisk system of port and sea-area threat assessments.

tools.name: S&P Global Market Intelligence
tools.description: Sea-web and the Maritime Portal (the ship database descended from Lloyd's Register-Fairplay), satellite AIS from the former ORBCOMM business, and Panjiva trade data.

tools.name: Sayari
tools.description: Corporate ownership graph built from public records in many jurisdictions, with trade and sanctions risk screening.

tools.name: Sea-Intelligence
tools.description: Liner schedule reliability and container market research.

tools.name: Sourcemap
tools.description: Supplier mapping and traceability for regulatory due diligence. The free edition we once listed is gone.

tools.name: Starboard Maritime Intelligence
tools.description: Vessel risk and dark activity analytics aimed at governments and fisheries agencies in the Pacific and beyond.

tools.name: SynMax
tools.description: Theia, a dark vessel detection platform combining radar and optical imagery with AIS.

tools.name: TankerTrackers.com
tools.description: Tanker movements, floating storage and sanctioned oil flows from imagery and AIS. Retail tiers are closed to new subscribers.

tools.name: Unseenlabs
tools.description: Geolocation of ships from their radio-frequency emissions, independent of AIS.

tools.name: Volza
tools.description: Export and import shipment data for a large set of countries, sold by subscription.

tools.name: Vortexa
tools.description: Cargo-level tracking of oil, gas and refined products, with analytics on floating storage and shadow fleet flows.

tools.name: Windward
tools.description: AI risk scores for vessels and companies, dark activity and sanctions compliance workflows.

tools.name: Bellingcat auto-archiver
tools.description: Archives web pages, posts and media from a spreadsheet of URLs, with hashes and timestamps, so that a vessel page or a port notice is preserved before it changes.

tools.name: cue-kit
tools.description: Turns a video URL or file into extracted frames and a timestamped transcript that a language model can actually read, with a bundled Claude Code skill for asking questions about footage. Alpha, and useful for port and vessel videos.

tools.name: equasis-cli
tools.description: Looks up vessels, port state inspections, ownership history and company fleets in Equasis from the command line, an interactive shell or Python, handles batches of hundreds of ships, and flags renames, reflagging, detentions and missing P&I cover. Needs your own free Equasis account; install from PyPI or this repository only.

tools.name: gfw-api-python-client
tools.description: Official Python client for the Global Fishing Watch APIs: vessel search, events and presence grids straight into pandas.

tools.name: Hunchly
tools.description: Browser extension that captures and hashes every page you visit during an investigation, which is the evidence trail you want when a vessel page changes after you cite it.

tools.name: Kepler.gl
tools.description: Browser tool that plots millions of points from a CSV or GeoParquet file with a time slider, which is how we first look at a bulk AIS download.

tools.name: pyais
tools.description: Python library that decodes and encodes AIS NMEA sentences, the first thing you need to read a raw feed or a receiver log.

tools.name: QGIS
tools.description: Desktop GIS for laying AIS points, EEZ boundaries, bathymetry and satellite imagery on one map. Plugins pull Copernicus and Vantor open data in directly.

tools.name: Shodan
tools.description: Search engine for internet-exposed devices, including ships' satellite terminals and port systems. Its old AIS ship tracker is gone and AIS data is now sold only as a bulk dataset.

tools.name: SunCalc
tools.description: Sun position and shadow length for any place and time, for dating or placing a photograph of a ship or a port.

tools.name: Atlas Bear Academy
tools.description: Our professional development programmes in maritime security and supply chain intelligence.

tools.name: awesome-osint
tools.description: The largest general OSINT list, with about 1,450 entries. Its maritime section is three lines long, which is why this list exists.

tools.name: Bellingcat Online Investigation Toolkit
tools.description: Hundreds of tool pages with cost, requirements, limitations and ethical notes, including a maritime section updated in 2026. Our pointer for general OSINT tools.

tools.name: C4ADS
tools.description: Reports on illicit networks, sanctions evasion and the shadow fleet, with the data-driven method laid out in each one.

tools.name: Deep Dive by Rae Baker
tools.description: Maritime OSINT guides from the author of *Deep Dive*, including a maritime patterning framework, port analysis and a Raspberry Pi AIS receiver build.

tools.name: GIJN: Tracking Ships at Sea
tools.description: A reporter's guide to vessel tracking, ownership and imagery, with case examples.

tools.name: OSINT Framework
tools.description: A categorised tree of general OSINT tools with registration and pricing markers and a weekly link check.

tools.name: Peering Beyond the Clouds
tools.description: The 2023 guide to finding ships in Sentinel-1 radar imagery with the Ship Detection Tool, and the best short introduction to SAR for analysts.

tools.name: Summer School on Illicit Trade
tools.description: The annual summer school where this list gets used and tested each year, with sessions on maritime and supply-chain OSINT.

tools.name: UN AIS Handbook
tools.owner: UN Committee of Experts on Big Data, AIS Task Team
tools.description: The method handbook for cleaning and analysing AIS data for statistics, with worked examples. Most pages date from 2020 to 2023, but the fundamentals have not moved.
